Metabolic Syndrome
The association of obesity with the development of hypertension, type 2 diabetes, 
and consequent CVD further heightens the need for Nurse Practitioners to be edu-
cated in the role of nutrition in health promotion and disease prevention.3 Recent 
attention regarding risk for CHD has focused on a constellation of characteristics 
termed metabolic syndrome. A series of simple measurements, shown in Table 8-4
